title: Wayfare Pass Membership Terms — Netting Share by Member Standing
content:
# Netting share by member standing (Wayfare Pass)

**Clause.** Where Pass benefit is netted from a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) period fee refunded under the full refund window, the netting share depends on the member's standing: 50 percent of the netted benefit for a member who has held the membership for at least 24 whole months and has never had a membership fee refunded before; 75 percent for a member who does not meet that tier but has held it for at least 12 whole months and has had at most one earlier fee refund; the whole netted benefit for anyone else.

**Effect.** The amount withheld from the window refund for the netted benefit is the netted benefit multiplied by the netting share, rounded half up to the cent.

## Records read

- **Whole months held**: whole calendar months from the membership's enrollment date to the date of the refund.
- **Earlier fee refunds**: fee refund entries already on the membership ledger, whatever their refund basis.

## Tier table

| Whole months held | Earlier fee refunds | Share of the netted benefit withheld |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more | none | 50 percent |
| 24 or more | exactly one | 75 percent |
| 12 to 23 | none or one | 75 percent |
| 12 or more | two or more | the whole |
| under 12 | any | the whole |

## Edges (hypothetical)

- 24 months, no earlier refund: 50 percent; 23 months, no earlier refund: 75 percent.
- 12 months, one earlier refund: 75 percent; 11 months: the whole; 30 months with two earlier refunds: the whole.

## Figure (hypothetical)

A netted benefit of 13.10 at the 75 percent share: 9.825, rounded to 9.83 withheld. At 50 percent: 6.55.
